title: Shard Dominion
description: Late-90s Westwood-style RTS: a 17-mission three-act campaign with a real Seal/Harness choice that branches the whole final act, 3 factions, tech tiers, real construction, air power, storms, a living planet that hunts the greedy, saves/replays, a mission kit, and experimental 1v1/2v2 lockstep.
